subject: MAP & acceptance playbook — Orchard evaluation (timeline + QA triggers)
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & acceptance — Orchard trial next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Orchard is keen to move from trial scoping into a short evaluation (2–3 week) but procurement wants a clear MAP that defines success, exit gates, and acceptance tests before we spin up the pilot environment.

Can you share:
- A one-page mutual action plan with milestones and owners
- The acceptance tests you expect us to run (smoke, perf, accuracy checks) and pass/fail thresholds
- Any SLA or security checkpoints procurement must see before sign-off

We have a procurement review on Aug 7; if the MAP and acceptance criteria are clear by EOD Aug 5 we can keep to an Aug 12 pilot start.

Thanks —
Sarah Jennings
Head of Clinical Tools | Orchard Health

Attachments: none in this message
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah@orchardhealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2024 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance — Orchard trial next steps

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've sketched a compact MAP that covers milestone owners, dates, and the acceptance tests we recommend. High level below; attached is MAP_v3.xlsx with the breakout and task owners.

Quick summary (proposed):
- Week 0 (Aug 12): Environment provisioning + data ingest (owner: Orchard IT)
- Week 1 (Aug 13–19): Functional smoke tests + accuracy probe (owner: Redwood SE)
- Week 2 (Aug 20–26): Performance sampling + edge-case validation (owner: Orchard QA + Redwood)
- Go/No-Go review meeting Aug 27 (decision owners: Sarah, Marissa, Karthik)

Exit gates / acceptance tests (examples):
- Smoke: end-to-end inference pipeline returns valid structured output for 95% of canonical prompts
- Accuracy: top-level intent extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the shared test set
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 350ms for 128-token median seq (sampled load)
- Stability: no more than 1 service interruption >1m during the test window

Procurement asks we can supply: draft SLA, SOC 2 evidence pointers, and an evidence pack with test vectors and results. Karthik — I dropped a stub SLA in the drive (will attach PDF once legal gives a pass).

Next steps: I propose a 30-min checkpoint Friday 8/2 to lock thresholds and owners. If that works I'll update the MAP and push the MAP_v3.xlsx to the shared HubSpot link.

Attached: MAP_v3.xlsx (attachment stub)

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Strategist | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Jennings <sarah@orchardhealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2024 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance — Orchard trial next steps

Sarah / Marissa —

Thanks for the draft gates, Marissa. A couple procurement/legal asks we should resolve before Aug 7:
1) SLA draft — I uploaded SLA_draft_Orchard_2024.pdf for initial review. Key ask from Orchard procurement will be uptime and incident notification commitments.
2) Data retention / logging — Orchard needs a short statement on retention windows for inference logs and how long we keep KV caches for private deployments.
3) Exportability — please confirm export path for test results and a signed artifact (DocuSign) that confirms acceptance once tests pass.

Marissa — can you add the specific evidence artifacts we will attach to each acceptance gate (sample report names, where to find them in drive)? Jordan, do you have an ops contact we should loop for the provisioning runbook?

Regards,
Karthik

Attachments: SLA_draft_Orchard_2024.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Orchard Health Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2024 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance — Orchard trial next steps

Marissa — thanks for the rapid turnaround. Two small asks from our side after reviewing the MAP_v3: 

1) Could we loosen the initial accuracy threshold to F1 >= 0.85 for Week 1 (accuracy probe), with a requirement to reach 0.88 by the Week 2 performance pass? That helps us set a realistic staging bar while Redwood and Orchard iterate on prompt sets.
2) On the latency gate — the p95 figure is fine but procurement will ask for both p50 and p95 at the sample load so they can model cost. Can you capture both (p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms)?

We can make the procurement meeting Friday 8/7 if we have the MAP and evidence list by EOD Wed 8/6. Procurement's contact is procurement@orchardhealth.ai — copying them here.

Onwards —
Sarah

Thanks, Sarah — that adjustment makes sense. I've updated the MAP and the acceptance checklist in MAP_v3.xlsx and baked the evidence items into each gate. Summary of the finalized acceptance gates and artifacts: 

1) Environment provisioned (Aug 12) — evidence: provisioning log (provisioning_runbook.md), sample data ingest report
2) Smoke (Week 1) — pass: 95% structured-output validity on canonical set; artifact: smoke-report-week1.csv (attached to HubSpot record)
3) Accuracy probe (Week 1 → soft threshold) — pass: F1 >= 0.85 by Aug 19; artifact: accuracy-probe-v1.json, reviewer notes
4) Performance & stability (Week 2) — pass: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms at sampled load; artifact: perf-sample-report.html, uptime-log.csv
5) Go/No-Go (Aug 27) — consolidated evidence pack + signed DocuSign acceptance (DocuSign envelope id included in related_links)

Procurement items included: short SLA summary, SOC 2 pointer doc, and a data-retention note (logs retained 90 days; KV cache retention configurable per deployment and documented in MAP_v3.xlsx).

I'll push the final MAP_v3.xlsx and SLA_draft_Orchard_2024.pdf to the HubSpot deal and share a short DocuSign route for the acceptance signature after the Go/No-Go meeting. Jordan — our ops runbook contact is Will Hayes (will_hayes@redwood.com); looping him into the provisioning thread separately.

If procurement wants the final packet before Aug 7, I can export a single ZIP with the evidence stubs. Otherwise we'll bring the packet to the meeting on Aug 7 and lock the pilot start on Aug 12.

Thanks all —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Strategist | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
